about_the_game:
👋 Welcome to the Barista Dream Demo!

Step behind the counter and start your journey as a passionate barista. In this first-person simulator, it’s all about a warm atmosphere, attention to detail, and the joy of making the perfect cup of coffee.

This demo offers a taste of the core experience, guiding you through the first four customers. You'll get to explore the basic realistic coffee-making and the cozy, relaxing atmosphere.

But that's just a taste! The full version of Barista Dream has so much more to offer:

  • Latte Art & Social Media: Express your creativity with advanced latte art features and share your best creations on the in-game social media platform to increase your cafe's popularity.

  • Full Cafe Management: Take control of your business by managing prices, staff, and even diving into different adventures with mini-games.

  • Waiter System: When customers sit down, you can use the waiter system to manage their orders and clear tables.

  • Much More Content: The full game includes a vastly larger selection of recipes, ingredients, and customization options for your café.

If you enjoy your time with this short demo, be sure to add the full version to your Wishlist!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440 with 3,1 GHz or AMD FX-8150 with 3,6 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 460 (2 GB VRAM) or higher
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3820 with 3,6 GHz or AMD FX-8350 with 4,0 GHz or higher
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (4 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM) or higher
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee. Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.
